svg.desc: Capture antibody, sample antigen, detection antibody, enzyme signal, and calibrated readout.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: IgG Antibody
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Original IgG schematic with two continuous heavy chains, one shorter light chain per arm, a hinge and two antigen-binding tips. Symbolic configuration; no fixed conformation, subclass, affinity or activity is implied.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: 96-Well Plate
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Original vector 96-well microplate with an exact 8-by-12 well grid, selected media wells, and editable semantic regions.
